claim_text: Request only. Three decision groups are put to the owner - (1) the C3G first-step solve form, (2) OD-01/OD-02 scheduling and time semantics for the three schedule_metadata time fields, (3) OD-20 active-vs-extra motor output scope. Every decision state is not_made, no option is chosen, no numeric budget appears, and no derivation, approval or closure is recorded. Six committed sources are pinned by tracked HEAD SHA256/size at most.
